items.title: The unbounded derived category of modules supported in a specialization-stable subset is the full subcategory of complexes supported there, in finite dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement extends the equivalence between the derived category of modules supported in a specialization-stable subset and the full subcategory of complexes with that support from bounded below complexes to all complexes, at the cost of assuming that the ring has finite dimension (author lemma at source lines 1054-1059, label lemma-equal-full). The proof (source lines 1061-1076) first bounds the cohomological dimension of the support functor using the vanishing of local cohomology above the dimension of the ring together with the colimit description of the functor, then quotes the bounded below case and removes the boundedness hypothesis by a truncation argument: the i-th cohomology of the image depends only on the truncation in degrees at least -d + i (proof lines 1071-1073). The truncation argument on top of the bounded below equivalence is the content; all three input statements are reproduced as context spans. H2.
